name: Gene Denvers
source: He is [url=/c133307]Wanda's[/url] middle child and is the younger brother of [url=/c133330]Faye[/url] and the twin brother of [url=/c133307]Lois[/url]. He attends the same school where Wanda works. He is interested in sports, mainly basketball.
